method.name: envelope-dp/1
method.engine: numpy (log-mel spectral flux + energy VAD + monotonic DP)
notes: Whisper word times are not used; only the transcript text and segment bounds
segment bounds are soft anchors (±120 ms); VAD pauses are hard chunk edges
punctuation carries no duration and never gets a boundary
onset = prominent onset-envelope peak (optional attack refinement, off by default)

method.name: ctc-forced
notes: transcript text is trusted; CTC posteriors decide every boundary
long clips are chunked at pauses; token allocation is per ASR segment
confidence = mean posterior of the chosen CTC state over its frames
